d: The US midterm elections have delivered a major victory for the Democrats and a historic setback for President Donald Trump. In this ground report from New York, Sree Srinivasan, CEO and Co-founder of Digimentors, examines what the results mean for Trump’s remaining two years in office, as both chambers of Congress prepare to switch from Republican to Democratic control in January. He discusses the challenges Trump could face in working with an opposition-controlled Congress, the implications for US policy towards Iran and the political road ahead. The results could also reshape the race…
